subject: [PATCH v6 09/12] mm, swap: add debugfs counters for vswap

2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch adds two debugfs counters to track virtual swap usage in the Linux kernel. The first counter, 'used', tracks the number of virtual swap slots (pages) currently allocated. The second counter, 'alloc_reject', counts the cumulative number of pages whose vswap slot allocation failed. These counters are exposed under the '/sys/kernel/debug/vswap/' directory and can be used for debugging purposes.
